insight: Transcribed over 32 million patient visits in 2025, with 26,000+ clinicians across 1,300+ clinics on the platform.
name: Freed
tagline: AI medical scribe that turns patient visits into clinical notes and pushes them to EHRs.
description: Freed is an AI medical scribe for clinicians: it listens to patient visits and produces complete, specialty-templated clinical notes within moments of the encounter. Higher tiers add EHR push integration, visit-prep summaries, referral letters, and ICD-10/CPT coding. It is HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2 Type II certified, and does not store patient recordings.
edge: Aimed at solo and small practices: unlimited notes at $79/month with white-glove support, instead of enterprise contracts and per-seat minimums.
pros: Notes ready right after the visit
EHR push integration on Premier tier
cons: Coding and EHR push need Premier
